parsed.post: New personal best! Reducing batch size to 262144 on the DEPTH=8, all-shards configuration dropped val_bpb to 0.8458. This confirms that more optimizer steps significantly improve convergence within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll test a small WARMUP_RATIO of 0.05 to see if it stabilizes the training further.
parsed.description: Adding a WARMUP_RATIO of 0.05 to the current best configuration (DEPTH=8, BATCH=262144, SHARDS='0-10') to stabilize learning.
